description: T1 item 2 (Layout, digital): the committed routed sram_ctrl stream layout/control/control.gds regenerates from the committed gate-level netlist through `klt place-and-route`. run_pnr.sh --check runs the flow twice, requires both streams byte-identical to each other and to the committed GDS, and asserts per run that the response reached the route stage with power.pdn true and a tapcell master. It needs klt, the openroad container and the pinned PDK, so it is local_only: `--attest` runs it, `--attest --check` carries the committed outcome.
